name: Library
text: You find yourself surrounded by shelves of ancient books.

pass.text: You discover a book with a few coins hidden away.

fail.text: You pull the wrong book and the entire shelf begins to fall. You are crushed to death under the weight.

name: Bedroom
text: A bed sits beneath a thick layer of dust in the corner of the room.

pass.text: You find a ruby under the mattress.

fail.text: Something beneath the bed grabs your ankle and pulls you under. You are dragged away never to be seen again.

name: Flooded Chamber
text: An underground room is half-filled with dark, stagnant water.

pass.text: You manage to wade through without incident.

fail.text: Something moves beneath the water. You are suddenly pulled under. Everything goes dark.

name: Kitchen
text: Pots hang from the ceiling, and everything is covered in dust

pass.text: You find a coin purse under the table.

fail.text: You open a cupboard and a family of rats explodes out of it. They gnash and bite at you until you succumb to your wounds.
